title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d) – Core Team
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst.

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird.

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert.

In den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle

  • Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut

  • Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen

Danach

  • Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung

  • Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird

  • Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis

  • Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen

  • Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede

  • Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun


Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung

  • Du kannst ein Datenmodell beurteilen und eine Architekturdiskussion moderieren, ohne sie an dich zu reißen

  • Du willst wieder oder weiter Code schreiben, bevor du führst, und siehst das als Vorteil, nicht als Umweg

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in Messstellenbetrieb, Abrechnung, Marktkommunikation oder Mieterstrom. Du kennst Begriffe wie Messkonzept, MaLo oder OBIS nicht nur aus Wikipedia

  • Business-Verständnis: Du denkst vom Geschäftsmodell des Betreibers her, nicht vom Feature. Du kannst erklären, welche Anforderung Umsatz sichert, welche Risiko reduziert und welche nur schön ist

  • Du gibst direktes Feedback und hältst es aus, direktes Feedback zu bekommen

  • Du kannst Nein sagen, zu Stakeholdern und zum eigenen Team, und begründen, warum

  • Du fühlst dich in einem Startup wohl, in dem Strukturen noch entstehen und du sie mitgestaltest

  • Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, weil Fachlichkeit, Kunden und ein Großteil der Kommunikation deutsch sind


Warum wir?

  • Eine Führungsrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einer wachsenden Engineering-Organisation, mit einem Einstieg, der dich nicht ins kalte Wasser wirft

  • Direkter Draht zum CTO und Mitsprache bei der Teamstruktur, nicht nur bei der Umsetzung

  • Hybrid in Hamburg: 1-2 Tage im Office, der Rest remote

  • Ein Team ohne Hierarchieebenen. Wer eine bessere Idee hat, setzt sie um

  • Zuschuss zu Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing, Urban Sports Club und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge

  • Ein Produkt, das die Energiewende konkret voranbringt, statt sie nur in die Präsentation zu schreiben

title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
description:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

  • You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations.

  • You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements.

  • You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

  • Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products.

  • Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

  • Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you!

title: Senior Electronic Warfare Engineer
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do 

  • Own the system architecture of Hypersonica's Electronic Warfare (EW) capability, ensuring electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), and electronic protection (EP) functions operate as a coherent and mission-effective system. 

  • Define, maintain, and manage EW system requirements, ensuring full traceability from operational needs through system architecture, subsystem allocation, verification, and validation. 

  • Lead the development of EW system architectures, performance budgets, interface definitions, and mission integrations across airborne platforms and payloads. 

  • Conduct threat, signal, and electromagnetic environment analyses to assess system effectiveness against representative adversary capabilities and operational conditions. 

  • Lead the integration of RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antenna systems, signal processing functions, mission computers, and platform interfaces into a coherent operational capability. 

  • Define and oversee system-level modelling, simulation, laboratory testing, ground trials, and flight trials, using evidence-based analysis to drive design improvements and risk reduction. 

  • Produce and maintain critical systems engineering artefacts including system specifications, interface control documents (ICDs), verification strategies, test plans, and design review materials. 

  • Apply model-based systems engineering (MBSE) principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and operational outcomes. 

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks, particularly around electromagnetic performance, interoperability, survivability, cybersecurity, verification, and platform integration. 

  • Act as the technical authority for EW system engineering, working across RF, software, hardware, mission systems, cybersecurity, safety, and platform engineering disciplines to deliver robust operational capability. 


Who you are 

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex Electronic Warfare, RF, mission systems, avionics, aerospace, defence, or other mission-critical systems. 

  • Strong background in systems architecture, requirements development, requirements decomposition, verification, and validation throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

  • Deep understanding of Electronic Warfare concepts, including electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), electronic protection (EP), threat systems, and electromagnetic spectrum operations. 

  • Experience integrating RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antennas, signal processing systems, and mission computers into operational platforms. 

  • Strong knowledge of electromagnetic environments, system performance analysis, modelling, simulation, and test methodologies. 

  • Familiar with MBSE approaches and capable of applying systems engineering rigour to complex, multidisciplinary defence programmes. 

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, platform integration activities, flight trials, qualification programmes, and operational capability development. 

  • Technically credible across multiple disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction confidently. 

  • Comfortable operating within fast-moving, high-accountability environments where ambiguity is high and execution speed matters. 

  • Motivated by solving nationally significant defence challenges and building capabilities that directly contribute to European security and technological independence. 


Security and Eligibility Requirement 

Due to the nature of the work done at Hypersonica, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for Security Clearance. 


What we offer 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

  • Ability to think creatively and strategically and translate strategic thinking into solid deliverables and plans

Nice to Have

title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
description:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.

title: SAP Account Executive (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.


Your Mission

  • Lead and long-term grow a team of AI engineers, providing both strategical technical direction and people leadership
  • Own MLOps processes and infrastructure, ensuring our AI systems are reliable, scalable, and secure
  • Drive the design and implementation of advanced AI features, partnering closely with engineering and product leadership to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines

  • Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and drive the build of new ones from scratch
  • Translate customer needs into technical priorities and represent AI engineering in strategic product and sales discussions
  • Establish and evolve engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices across the team
  • Coach and develop your team members, supporting their technical and professional growth
  • Champion the use of modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor across the team


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
  • 5+ years of experience in AI engineering and at least 1+ years in a leading position, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
  • Proven experience leading or managing a technical team, with strong people-leadership skills
  • Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
  • A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
  • A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
  • Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
  • Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week


Your Benefits

As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

title: Founding Commercial SDR - London
description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

What the job actually feels like

Most SDR jobs end when the meeting gets booked. This one starts there. You'll hear "no" ten times before you hear "yes." That "yes" is a 30-minute discovery call with a CFO, CPO or CIO at a Fortune 500 manufacturer, where you run the meeting, present the value proposition, and build the stakeholder map live. The Senior SDRs who win here treat every "no" as a data point and every "yes" as a chair at the table.

 

About the role

As a Founding Commercial Sales Development Representative, you will own the outreach into Commercial manufacturing and industrial accounts. You'll work closely with our Sales team to prospect and nurture relationships with CFO, CPO, CEO and CIO stakeholders, and drive sales opportunities for our Agentic AI platform automating Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash. You will have a proactive approach and work to accelerate the sales process, convert leads into qualified opportunities, and consistently hit sales targets.

 

Tech stack

You will work with a sharp outbound stack: HubSpot as our CRM and source of truth, Clay for enrichment and signal-based prospecting, Claude for AI assisted tasks and research, and LinkMatch to keep LinkedIn and HubSpot in sync without manual logging.

 

What you'll do

  • Take ownership of strategic outreach into Commercial manufacturing and industrial accounts through cold calls and personalized messages, engaging CFO, CPO, CEO and CIO stakeholders.

  • Craft tailored value propositions by understanding the unique pain points of stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, and IT in Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes.

  • Prospect large accounts and build multi-threaded stakeholder maps across Finance, Procurement, IT and the executive sponsor.

  • Run and present in 30-minute discovery calls with C-level stakeholders. You own the meeting, not just the booking.

  • Stay ahead of the market by continuously updating your commercial knowledge, analysing procurement and finance processes, and tracking industry trends in Agentic AI and ERP automation.

  • Prioritise complex tasks with clients, flagging bottlenecks early rather than late to keep things moving forward.

  • Carry a quota of 1.2M ARR closed-won sourced per year.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have 2-4 years of experience in a B2B SaaS sales environment, ideally selling into manufacturing, industrial or finance/procurement buyers, and a track record of building stakeholder maps in commercial accounts while consistently exceeding sales targets.

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and persuasively, with the ability to adapt your style to a CFO, CPO, CEO or CIO conversation.

  • You handle rejection with resilience and keep your momentum through long, multi-stakeholder commercial sales cycles.

  • You're a team player with a sense of ownership and accountability.

  • You enjoy problem-solving and have a natural curiosity that drives you to find creative solutions.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience selling into Manufacturing, Industrial or Finance/procurement buyers, are familiar with ERP systems or sales tech such as Hubspot and Claude.

 

What you'll get

  • Training and development. Enjoy a 3-month onboarding process with ongoing support to set you up for success.

  • Fair lead allocation. We make sure the playing field is level for everyone. AI algorithms decide, not managers.

  • High earning potential. Uncapped commission and expected 6-figure package, and opportunity to participate in common share equity program.

  • Equal OTEs. As we share the same incentives, you'll be comped as the Account Executives.

  • Flexible locations. Zurich, Munich, Cologne, London. Come work in one of our offices. If you are not based in Zurich, you are welcome to visit your colleagues regularly.

  • Opportunities to grow. You're controlling your personal development and career trajectory in a rapidly growing, internationally expanding startup.

  • Exceptional colleagues. You'll be growing alongside individuals from exceptional academic backgrounds and careers.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Front-End Web Specialist (12-month fixed term contract)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As a Front-End Web Specialist, you’ll be the connective tissue between our web team and the rest of the business. This role exists because great websites aren’t just built — they’re coordinated, prioritised, and protected from chaos. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing and Web Development, you’ll own the intake and lifecycle of web requests, ensure every project is properly scoped before it touches the dev queue, and support the team in delivering an ambitious web roadmap.

But this role doesn’t stop at coordination. You’ll also be hands-on in the quality of what we ship — reviewing copy and UX before pages go live, supporting CRO initiatives, and acting as a critical second pair of eyes on every significant release. You care as much about whether a page converts as whether it launches on time.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, understands how a website is actually built, and can hold your own in a room with developers, designers, and marketers alike, this is your role.


What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

Process & Reporting

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership


What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in a web operations, technical/digital project management, or web production role, ideally with hands-on CMS or front-end exposure — not purely marketing coordination

  • Working technical literacy: solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, understanding of how a CMS is structured (Storyblok, Contentful, Webflow or similar), staging vs. production workflows, and what a QA process actually checks

  • Comfortable using AI tools hands-on in production (prompting for drafts, QA’ing AI output) and able to articulate where AI isn’t reliable enough to trust unsupervised

  • Product/project-management instincts: can scope a request, size complexity, sequence competing priorities, and brief external developers with minimal hand-holding

  • Confident translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable pushing back on a brief or a deadline when needed

  • Strong written communication: a clear brief, a precise QA note, a concise status update

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Marketing Manager - Manda
description:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own how business owners find manda, iwoca's M&A platform. You'll be our first marketing hire, joining as we open the platform to business owners who don't yet bank with iwoca. Almost everything about how we reach them is still to be decided, and you'll be the one deciding it.

The team

You'll be our first marketing hire, joining a founding team of circa 10 mandans. All highly motivated to finally free the SME M&A space from the lack of meaningful innovation in the space.

You'll get the autonomy and pace of a startup, with the data, infrastructure and credibility of an established lender behind you. You'll report directly into the Venture Lead of manda.

Your mission

Your mission is to bring the right business owners to manda: people genuinely thinking about selling, at the point in their lives when they're thinking about it.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but it doesn't scale and the pool is finite. Your job is to build the channels that reach owners who have never heard of iwoca, work out which of those channels produce real mandates at a cost our fee model can support, and shut down the ones that don't.

You won't be inheriting a growth engine. We're launching our direct application journey this autumn, and filling it is your first job. You'll be building the first growth engine here, and you'll be the person who decides where the money goes.

The role

Find the channels that work

  • Run cheap, fast tests across direct channels such as paid search, paid social, organic, and direct response. Prioritise those that work and kill the ones that don't, based on evidence.

  • Own the budget and the allocation decisions. You'll start small on purpose: we'd rather learn which channel works than spend heavily on one that doesn't.

  • Write and test the copy yourself, from ads to landing pages, and iterate on what real business owners actually respond to.

  • Test offline as well as digital. Mail and email direct to business owners are two of the few ways to reach someone who isn't actively searching for a way out, and nobody has tested either properly for us yet.

  • Earn coverage in the trade press. We have real deals to talk about now, and working with iwoca's comms team you should be able to turn them into a steady source of inbound interest.

Prove the unit economics

  • Establish what it actually costs us to acquire a seller mandate through each channel. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it — replacing it with a real number is one of the most valuable things you can do in your first six months.

  • Define how we value a lead before it becomes a deal. Our conversion event is months away from first contact and worth a lot when it lands, so you'll need a sensible proxy to steer spend against.

Build the measurement first

  • Set up attribution, with needed tech support, so that customers can be traced back to the channel that produced them.

  • Build the reporting that tells the team which channels are working, and be the person who questions a number that looks too good.

Turn our website into something that converts

  • Make the case for manda clearly: what the process involves, how long each step takes, and why we're different from a traditional broker.

  • Use our completed deals, our team's track record and our acquisition finance offering as proof, and test what actually persuades a cautious owner to start a conversation about selling.

Help us reach better buyers

  • Sellers come first, but manda is a two-sided market. Once seller supply is working, you'll help us reach acquirers who are serious, credible and ready to transact, including buyers who are new to iwoca.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in acquisition, growth or generalist marketing, ideally in a startup, scale-up or new venture where you had to work out what to do rather than execute someone else's plan.

  • M&A, marketplace or two-sided experience, especially where supply rather than demand was the constraint.

  • Comfortable with a long, low-frequency, high-value conversion. Selling a business is nothing like taking out a loan: the cycle runs for months, volumes are low, and you'll have to make decisions on thin and noisy data without waiting for statistical comfort.

  • Numerate and data-literate. You build the measurement before the campaign, you can read a funnel, and you're happy owning the numbers you report.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team and no agency to hide behind: you'll write the copy, brief the page, set up the tracking and pull the reporting yourself.

  • Experience driving applications or sign-ups into a live product journey, and comfortable working with product and engineering on the conversion steps you don't own yourself.

  • A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture.

Bonus:

  • Experience marketing to owner-managers of established SMEs, particularly around retirement, succession or exit.

  • You've personally owned a paid channel with a real budget, and you've killed one that wasn't working. We care as much about the second part as the first.

  • Regulated or financial services marketing experience.

  • Offline direct response experience, particularly direct mail.

  • Hands-on with HubSpot, GA4 or similar, and comfortable with SQL or a BI tool like Looker.

The salary

We expect to pay from £55,000–£80,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days' holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we've been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We’re looking for a Partnership Manager - manda (iwoca's M&A Platform)

We're looking for someone to build the introducer network that brings business owners to manda, iwoca's M&A platform. Accountants, solicitors, wealth managers and brokers meet an owner who is thinking about retiring long before we do. Your job is to make sure that when they do they think of us, and that referring us is the easiest thing they do that day.

The role

Your mission is to build a referral channel that produces a steady flow of business owners who are genuinely ready to sell.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but the pool is finite. The professionals who already advise business owners are the most credible route to the ones we'd otherwise never reach, and right now we have no systematic way of working with them.

You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up.

It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses.

Key responsibilities include:

Build the introducer network

  • Find and win the firms worth working with: accountancy practices, corporate finance boutiques, solicitors, wealth managers and business transfer agents. Work out which kinds of firm actually refer, and concentrate there.

  • Do the outbound yourself. Identify the firm, get the meeting, make the case, and follow up until something happens.

  • Design what we offer them: how a referral is made, what the partner gets, what we commit to in return, and how we keep them informed once their client is with us.

Make referrals actually arrive

  • A signed partnership is worth nothing until a referral comes through. You'll own the ongoing relationship work that turns agreements into a flow: regular contact, keeping manda front of mind, briefing partner teams, and being the person they call.

  • Track referral volume and quality by partner, and be honest about which relationships aren't working so we can stop spending time on them.

Make the channel scale

  • Judge every partnership by whether it adds referrals without adding work. A relationship that only produces when you're in the room isn't a channel yet.

  • Work out which partner technology is worth plugging into: the practice management and accounting software advisers already work in, tracked referral links and partner portals, and integrations that let a firm refer a client without leaving their own tools. You won't build these yourself, but you'll identify them, make the commercial case, and scope them with our Product Builder.

  • Look for partners who can bring a book rather than one client at a time. One firm with hundreds of owner-managed clients is worth more to us than ten firms with five, if we can find a way to surface the right candidates across the whole book.

Work iwoca's existing network

  • iwoca already has a broker network and a partnerships function with relationships across the SME economy. Working out where manda fits into those relationships is far faster than starting cold, and it's the first place to look.

Events and community

  • Build a focused programme of events worth attending and, where it makes sense, running our own: succession and exit planning, accountancy and adviser events, industry gatherings, and business owner peer communities.

  • Judge them on referrals rather than attendance, and stop going to the ones that don't produce. Events are how you find and land partners, not how the channel scales.

Prove the channel pays

  • Establish what a referral actually costs us once your time, any partner incentives and events are counted, and how many convert into a signed mandate. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in partnerships, channel or business development, ideally B2B, where you built or substantially grew a referral channel rather than inheriting one that already worked.

  • You've done the full cycle yourself: identified the target firms, got the meetings, agreed the terms, and then managed the relationship afterwards.

  • A background in M&A, marketplaces, business broking or business transfer.

  • You understand that the work starts after the agreement is signed, and you have the discipline to keep a channel warm over months rather than weeks.

  • Numerate and honest about performance. You track referrals by partner, you know which relationships are producing, and you say so when one isn't.

  • You think in systems as well as relationships. You can tell the difference between a partnership that scales and one that only works while you're pushing it, and you'd rather replace your own manual work with an integration than defend it.

  • Comfortable specifying technology without building it. You can look at a partner's tools and our product, work out what would make us the path of least resistance, and scope it clearly enough for a product team to build.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team to delegate to: you'll build the target list, send the emails, run the meetings and keep the CRM straight yourself.

  • A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture.

Bonus:

  • Experience with accountancy, legal or wealth management channels specifically.

  • Experience running an event programme with commercial targets attached to it.

  • Familiarity with the UK succession and exit planning landscape.

  • Comfortable treating a CRM as a discipline rather than an afterthought, ideally HubSpot.

  • You've shipped a partner integration, an embedded referral flow or a software marketplace listing, or worked closely with a product team on one.

title: Account Executive
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our new SME team, selling into the eCommerce, SaaS and Professional Services industries. These are fast-growing businesses operating internationally, and we're the only fintech with the payment infrastructure, software and AI layer to streamline how they get paid, manage treasury and pay suppliers from one system. Your job is to understand their priorities, surface where their finance systems are holding them back, and build the case for change.

What you will be doing

Pipeline and new business generation

  • Territory planning: prioritising accounts and the people worth reaching out to, as well as identifying routes in through partners or leadership connections.

  • Owning your outbound strategy: building a hypothesis on what a business is prioritising and where things are likely breaking, then getting to the right people. Our product evolves quickly, so we need reps who develop new angles as they open up.

  • Running a proven sales process, and iterating on it: understanding a business's priorities, the challenges preventing them from executing, and building the ROI case with the customer.

  • Forecasting: using MEDDPICC to know where you are in a deal, where the gaps are, and to forecast accordingly.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Implementation and account management: coordinating implementation and handover, including the mutual action plans that keep everyone aligned on timelines and get the customer adopting quickly.

  • Product: relaying customer insight to the product team and influencing roadmap priorities.

  • Marketing: working together on ABM campaigns, competitive positioning and customer case studies.

What you bring

Experience

  • Ideally 3+ years of B2B software or fintech sales experience, with at least 1 year in an outbound closing role.

  • If you have 2+ years in an outbound lead generation role and have been deliberate about upskilling for a move into closing, apply and tell us how.

Skills and mindset

  • Curious: about the industries we sell into, the people we sell to, and our own product. You want to understand how things actually work, not just what to say about them. You think on your feet and you're clear and concise with your communication.

  • Perceptive: you read a room, and you have genuine empathy for the people you're selling to and working alongside.

  • Driven: the motivation comes from you. You want to get better, and you keep working through the stretches where results lag effort.

  • Honest: you bring problems forward early rather than letting them surface late, and you're upfront when you don't know something.

  • Coachable: you take feedback and act on it quickly, while being critical enough about what you hear to apply it selectively.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

What you'll do

As Senior Sales Manager, SME and Growth, you will lead, coach and develop a team of 10 Account Executives serving SME and mid-market customers in the UK.   • Support strategic and complex opportunities by joining customer meetings, coaching negotiation and objection handling, engaging senior stakeholders and preserving clear Account Executive ownership throughout the sales cycle.

  • Build and improve outbound sales motions with Sales Development and Marketing by refining target segments, account coverage, messaging, outreach cadences and reporting.

  • Maintain high standards of CRM hygiene, data quality and forecasting discipline, using pipeline coverage, stage conversion, win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy to identify risks and prioritise action.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • At least 6 years of B2B sales experience, including significant experience as a closing Account Executive selling to SME, SMB or mid-market customers, and at least 2 years of frontline sales leadership experience managing, mentoring or coaching Account Executives in a quota-carrying sales environment.

  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding individual and team sales targets, with experience owning or contributing to a team quota.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close, including discovery, value selling, negotiation, objection handling and close planning.

  • Strong practical knowledge of MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPICED, Challenger or an equivalent sales methodology, with the ability to train, inspect and reinforce its use across a team.

  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing pipeline, inspecting opportunities, forecasting accurately and maintaining disciplined CRM standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and performance-manage Account Executives, including providing clear feedback and addressing under-performance fairly and effectively.

  • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, payments or financial services, together with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling multi-product fintech or payments solutions, such as payments, foreign exchange, business accounts, cards or spend management, to founders, CFOs, Finance, Operations or business-owner stakeholders.

  • Experience building or scaling a sales team, market, outbound motion or go-to-market strategy in the UK, EMEA or another developing market.

  • Experience implementing sales methodologies across a team, including creating enablement materials, inspection frameworks, coaching routines and performance measures.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and modern sales tools such as Gong, Chorus, Outreach, Salesloft or AI-enabled sales platforms, together with an interest in using data and technology to improve sales productivity.

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Welcome to ProcessOut

ProcessOut is a pioneer in the payment orchestration space. We are on a mission to help merchants build, scale and optimize their payment infrastructure. We work to bring simplicity, flexibility & performance to payments.

Millions of transactions are routed via ProcessOut everyday for merchants all over the world. We are proud to partner with amazing merchants like Glovo, Bolt, Sainsbury’s, Dott, Rakuten and many more!

We were acquired by Checkout.com in 2020 with the goal of growing our global reach.

If you are looking to join a very fast-moving company with passionate, hard-working & fun teams, ProcessOut is for you! At ProcessOut, we are looking for people who are convinced they can play a central part in the Company's success! We are looking for people who are passionate, who are looking to achieve their full potential & who will actively contribute to strengthen the links between our teams. We value people that fully own their work and are passionate about building the next generation of online payments with us.

The role

At ProcessOut, Implementation Engineers play a central role in the success of the Company. We are looking for a highly motivated person to join our Merchant Experience team and work alongside colleagues to help customers get world-class guidance and advice during the implementation of ProcessOut.

You will play a critical role in helping customers go-live, in maintaining their trust and ensuring a strong feedback loop within our teams to continuously improve our products suite.

  • Native level French or English communication skills complemented by a strong business acumen.

  • Able to read and analyze server and application logs and debug errors.

  • Strong experience working with REST HTTP APIs.

  • Strong experience in project management, and ideally customer onboarding.

  • Ability to investigate and solve complex technical problems to offer the best solutions to our customers.

Bonus points for

  • Experience in a similar role in a tech company.

  • Experience and knowledge working in the online payments industry.

  • Prior customer service experience working in a merchant-facing role.

  • Advanced data analytics skills, preferably with proficiency in sophisticated tools and demonstrated examples of analytical work.

  • Experience working with Javascript to design and build small application scripts.

  • Ability to read and understand application code (Golang).

  • Partner internally with account managers, technical support, and engineers to resolve issues during customer trials, integrations, or post-implementation support.

  • Interact with the Product/Engineering teams to pinpoint improvement ideas.

  • Advise Management on project statuses and potential issues that impact customer satisfaction and provide recommendations for appropriate actions.

  • Ability to multitask with multiple projects and integrations of key customers

  • Maintain and update our merchant-facing documentation to continuously help reduce friction during the implementation phase.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning.

Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects.


Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research.

Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations.

Starting date: Fall 2026
